user.title: Connect to a base station
user.description: Enter the address of your CollectShine base station. Its name on the network works too, for example collectshine-3f2a.local.

token.title: Agent token
token.description: In the CollectShine app, go to Settings → AI agent access and create a token. It is shown once. {error_detail}

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect to {name}
reauth_confirm.description: This base station no longer accepts the saved token. Create a new one in the CollectShine app under Settings → AI agent access. {error_detail}

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the base station at that address.
error.invalid_auth: The base station rejected that token.
error.subscription_required: This base station will not accept agent access right now.
error.unsupported_version: This base station is newer than the integration. Update the CollectShine integration.

abort.already_configured: This base station is already set up.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the base station.
abort.unsupported_version: This base station is newer than the integration. Update the CollectShine integration.

data.power_on: Switch the shelf lights on when finding a record

data_description.power_on: A spotlight on a shelf whose lights are off is accepted by the hardware and shows nothing, so leaving this on is usually what you want.

find_record.name: Find a record
find_record.description: Find a record in the collection and light it on the shelf.

query.name: Query
query.description: The record to find, in ordinary words.
